title: Chapter 681
text:
"Huff … Huff …"

Sylvia was wearing a lightweight mechanical suit and had her shield open the entire time. The head protection device of the suit was a half circle of metal mechanical rings that wrapped around the back of her head and fixed on her ears. Her face was protected by the semi-transparent arc-shaped shield, and she was holding a silver alloy sword in her hand.

She was panting heavily like a bellows. She felt like her lungs were about to burn, and her sweat stuck to the mechanical suit, making it sticky and slippery.

Roar!

A Thousand Beast Soldier suddenly charged out from the side. Its huge metal mechanical claw attacked, and the claw vibrated at a high frequency, making it look blurry.

Sylvia clenched her teeth, raised her sore arm, and swung the thin and tough silver alloy sword in her hand. The claw and sword clashed, creating dazzling sparks.

Clang!

The light but tough mechanical suit buzzed and increased its output. Sylvia's speed suddenly increased, and she quickly changed her attack. She spun the sword and stabbed it toward the Thousand Beast Soldier from a strange angle. Mechanical Force flashed on the alloy sword, and a bright yellow light flowed on the blade, instantly stabbing into the body of this Thousand Beast Soldier.

Bang!

A thick yellow beam of light pierced through the Thousand Beast Soldier's body and came out from its back, leaving behind a huge bloody hole. This Thousand Beast Soldier was blown away and fell to the metal ground, dying instantly. Around it were countless Thousand Beast Soldier corpses and destroyed cannons.

This was the surface battlefield of one of the satellite fortresses in the Bloodshed Land's logistics transit station. A landing team was struggling to advance toward the core energy furnace of the satellite fortress. Thousand Beast Soldiers swarmed in from all directions, and the two sides fought fiercely. Wherever they passed, they left behind a trail of corpses.

Sylvia had countless comrades around her, either firing with heavy cannons or blocking with electromagnetic shields. She was also a member of the landing team, protecting the flanks.

She had been fighting for a long time with her sword, and she could not remember whether she had killed a hundred or two hundred Thousand Beast Soldiers. Her battle suit was damaged, and she had suffered light injuries. She was already drenched in sweat and exhausted.

In the middle of the battlefield, the sounds of explosions and roars were deafening. Sylvia could not hear anything else. She only knew that she had to keep moving forward with the army.

He raised his head and glanced at the sky. Outside the satellite fortress, there was a magnificent scene of an interstellar war. Countless resplendent 'shooting stars' streaked across the pitch-black sky, weaving a net of light. This was the radiance of countless ion cannons, illuminating the ancient darkness and burning brightly in the silence.

Sylvia's vision was suddenly shrouded by a strong light. A plasma cannon landed on the ground not far away, hitting the black mass of Ten Thousand Beast Soldiers and blowing up a large number of figures.

Boom!!

Occasionally, the fleet would be able to temporarily break through the satellite's protective shield, providing support and clearing the obstacles that prevented the landing team from reaching the entrance of the energy furnace.

"It almost hit us." Sylvia still had a lingering fear. Before she could catch her breath, a few more light cannons were fired at her. She had no choice but to enlarge the shield on her arm and block them.

Bang! Bang!

Sparks exploded on the shield, and her arm bore the brunt of the recoil. She felt a sharp pain in her arm and shoulder bones, and she almost could not lift them up. Sylvia gritted her teeth and endured the pain. She wanted to cry but had no tears.

I really want to go back and study!

At least my life is not in danger!

Three years ago, Sylvia had reached Grade B and excitedly reported the good news to Han Xiao. Han Xiao was very pleased and threw her into the vanguard team for actual combat training.

At first, Sylvia was quite happy, but now, she was filled with regret.

Especially since the direct superior of this team was Lagi. Before every battle, Lagi would follow the procedures in the work manual and routinely boost the morale of his subordinates. Every time, she felt that she was definitely going to die.

At this moment, a dark figure suddenly flew over from the distant horizon and landed heavily on the ground not far away. Under the impact of the huge force, the metal ground seemed to have turned into paper paste. It twisted and wrinkled, and a crater was smashed into it.

This figure seemed to have fallen quite heavily, and it took him a long time to get up and fly into the sky. His gaze then turned toward the landing team Sylvia was in.

Seeing the appearance of this person, Sylvia's heart sank. This person was the enemy Calamity Grade Super in charge of the logistics transit station. He should have been fighting in outer space, but he had actually landed on the surface of the satellite. It seemed like he had been shot down.

The battlefield changed rapidly, and the expressions of everyone in the landing team changed. They all turned toward this Calamity Grade Super who had suddenly appeared and prepared to attack. They did not have a Calamity Grade Super leading them.

Just when everyone was extremely nervous, another meteor fell from the sky and slammed into this Calamity Grade Super, sending him dozens of kilometers away. A sonic boom was created, and the surrounding Thousand Beast Soldiers were blown away. The strong wind blew Sylvia and the others to the ground.

"It's His Excellency Marian!"

"Too timely. I almost thought I was going to die."

Sylvia heard the exclamations behind her. She steadied herself with her sword and looked over. The 'meteor' that had sent the Calamity Grade Super flying was floating in the air. It was the Grade A Mechanical Pugilist who had joined the Black Star Corps three years ago, Marian.

Marian was completely covered in a black super-heavy mech. He looked like a heavy armored knight. He turned his head and looked at the landing team. He nodded slightly, indicating that the landing team should continue forward and not worry about anything else.

He then accelerated and disappeared from the spot, chasing after the enemy Calamity Grade Super while focusing on his own opponent.

"I wonder how the battle above is going …"

Sylvia retracted her gaze and looked up at the sky again. Her gaze seemed to be able to penetrate the darkness. She knew that her teacher was in charge of the fleet and controlling the entire situation.

At the same time, Section Zero's fleet was crazily attacking the logistics transit station, destroying the enemy battleships one after another.

Han Xiao was in the command room of the flagship, observing the real-time projection of the battlefield, mobilizing the troops, and commanding the entire situation. He was surrounded by a circle of advisors and assistants.

Compared to three years ago, Han Xiao's aura was more stable. He had a simple hairstyle, sharp facial features, and green stubble on his chin. He had a necklace of compressed orbs around his neck, and he was wearing a large black windbreaker. However, it was unable to cover his muscular body, and he exuded the sexiness of a mature man from head to toe.

His current identity was the first commander of this fleet.

This was a standard mixed fleet, and forty-five percent of the fleet belonged to Han Xiao. It was the largest fleet, and the rest were under the command of a few Section Zero members, all of whom were under Han Xiao's command.

After three years of development, the Black Star Corps had become one of the top members of Section Zero. A year ago, Purple Crystal had finally reached an agreement with Han Xiao, and the Black Star Corps had become a long-term partner. Purple Crystal had become the publicly acknowledged leader of Section Zero, and Han Xiao himself had the qualifications to be the commander.

Under Purple Crystal's arrangement, Han Xiao was able to command this fleet and was in charge of the logistics transit station for the expedition to Bloodshed Land. He had already been fighting outside for half a year.

Being the commander meant that he could not be mobilized easily. Han Xiao no longer took the vanguard and left everything to his subordinates. It just so happened that the army had recruited a few new Grade A Supers three years ago, and they were all very useful. They were all reliable talents, and he no longer lacked high-level combatants.

As long as they did not meet an expert that they could not deal with, he would not need to take action.

He had to nurture his officers and give them a chance to obtain merits. After all, once he took action, his subordinates would not be able to play.

At this moment, a few advisors were observing the battlefield projection and discussing loudly.

"The enemy is still resisting, covering the logistics team and transporting the resources in the transit station through the stargate. They want to reduce their losses. If we don't stop them, the enemy will be able to retrieve most of the resources and retreat through the stargate in twenty-seven minutes."

"Not to mention twenty-seven minutes, they won't even be able to hold on for ten minutes. The enemy's defense line has completely collapsed."

"Next, as long as we blow up the stargate, the enemy who has yet to retreat will be dead for sure."

Listening to everyone's discussion, Han Xiao stroked his stubble and did not say a word.

The core facility of the logistics transit station was a stargate built by a Star Cluster civilization. The other side was connected to the Sol Cluster. The enemy had set up a satellite fortress and a fleet to protect the stargate. After being attacked, they would retreat through the stargate while defending.

Once the enemy retreated, Han Xiao would not be able to chase after them. The other side of the stargate was the enemy's territory. If the stargate was closed, they would be surrounded. Therefore, the condition for victory was to destroy the stargate before the enemy completely retreated.

The stargate was a two-way channel, and the enemy's reinforcements could arrive through the stargate. The enemy needed time to mobilize reinforcements, and the attacking side had the initiative. Therefore, as long as the stargate was destroyed first, the battle would be over.

The Black Star Corps had obtained a huge amount of resources in the past few years. Therefore, Han Xiao was willing to spend a lot to greatly expand his fleet. Therefore, the scale of this expedition fleet was extremely large, and their strength completely crushed the defense team of the transit station. The battlefield projection showed that the enemy's defense line had collapsed, and the stargate was exposed.

Seeing this, an adjutant laughed. "The enemy has no chance. We've won."

As soon as he said that, the blue vortex in the center of the stargate rippled and spat out battleships one after another. The reinforcements of the Bloodshed Land had arrived and immediately joined the battle, blocking the attacks of the fleet.

Han Xiao speechlessly glanced at the deputy who spoke. This person had an awkward expression, coughed, avoided Han Xiao's gaze, and pretended to stare at the battlefield projection with a focused expression that said, "I'm analyzing the situation, don't disturb me."

"This is why I don't want to talk when the wind is blowing."

Han Xiao sighed.

The appearance of the enemy's reinforcements caused a chain reaction. On the other side, streams of light flew over from the desolate universe belt, and a huge fleet stopped at the edge of the battlefield. Together with the reinforcements of the Bloodshed Land, they surrounded Han Xiao's fleet.

"An ambush?" Everyone's expression changed.

"Oh, it seems like this logistics transit station is a trap." Han Xiao raised his brows, and his face was calm. He was not surprised at all.

The battle had gone so smoothly, and he had long noticed the problem. With so many logistics transit stations destroyed by him, how could the Bloodshed Land not respond?

The model of the battleship of this ambush fleet was completely different from the Bloodshed Land's. This was a fleet belonging to another organization. Over the past three years, organizations that wanted to strangle him in the cradle had secretly allied with the Bloodshed Land and participated in the secret war. Han Xiao had already encountered more than ten ambushes and traps specifically targeted at him. He was already used to it, and every day that he was not assassinated felt like something was missing.

Beep beep!

This time, the flagship received a video message from the ambush fleet. A man with metallic skin appeared on the screen. His entire body looked like it was made of metal, and his expression was murderous.

"Black Star, come out and fight!"

"Tsk, this guy is here again."

Han Xiao sighed. This person was also a Beyond Grade A seed. His name was Hardaway, and he was a battle maniac. A year ago, he had barged in during a battle and specifically wanted to spar with Han Xiao. After being defeated, he had escaped.

However, Hardaway did not give up on the challenge. After escaping, he took the initiative to form an alliance with the Bloodshed Land and used the opportunity of war to barge in again and again. He treated Han Xiao as a target to train himself and kept on fighting. Furthermore, when he saw that the situation was not good, he ran away extremely quickly. In Han Xiao's eyes, he was just a troublemaker.

Over the past three years, Han Xiao's list of connections had become longer, and at the same time, his enemies had increased as well.

"You guys take command. I have work to do."

Han Xiao's face was calm. He casually twisted his neck and walked toward the cabin door, leaving the people in the command room with his back as steady as an old dog.
